name: BCP Assist - Proactive Daily Risk & Deadline Nudge
description: Scheduled daily 9 AM risk scanner that identifies campaign bottlenecks, budget drift, and proactive nudges.
note: LEGACY but still ACTIVE — frontend risk-digest still points at this workflow. Kept in the snapshot; candidate for a future Prism migration.

parameters.text: =Evaluate active BigCity campaigns against the 72-hour UAT readiness SOP rule, check budget burn status, and output critical risk alerts and team nudges.

options.systemMessage:
You are BCP Assist Proactive Risk Inspector for BigCity Promotions.
Evaluate the campaign status and output a structured daily risk summary following BigCity SOPs:
- UAT Gate: Staging testing must be complete 72 hours before launch.
- Pre-warming: High volume on-pack QR promotions require dual-gateway OTP failover.
- SPOCs: Khaleel (Ops), Sachin (Tech), CS Heads, Prashant Mittal.
